skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated with cards Forge implements: a creature needs two separate instances of rampage, and no Forge card has two Rampage keywords or grants rampage to a creature that already has it (Rapid Fire grants rampage 2 only to a creature without rampage, and Gabriel Angelfire grants one instance of rampage 3 to itself); the single-instance trigger is covered by 702.23a-1

scenarios.title: Rampage gives +N/+N for each blocker beyond the first
decisions: A attacks player B with Wolverine Pack (2/4, rampage 2).
B blocks Wolverine Pack with two Grizzly Bears (the third Grizzly Bears does not block).
Wolverine Pack becomes blocked and its rampage trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.
Combat damage: A assigns Wolverine Pack's damage as 2 to each blocking Grizzly Bears when it has 4 or more power, and all of it to the single blocker otherwise.

variants.label: two_blockers
variants.expected: The rampage trigger resolves and Wolverine Pack gets +2/+2 until end of turn (one blocker beyond the first), becoming 4/6. It deals 2 damage to each blocking Grizzly Bears, so both are destroyed and move to B's graveyard. Wolverine Pack takes 4 damage and survives.

variants.label: one_blocker
variants.delta: B blocks Wolverine Pack with only one Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The rampage trigger resolves with no blockers beyond the first, so Wolverine Pack gets +0/+0 and stays 2/4. It deals 2 damage to the blocking Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. Wolverine Pack takes 2 damage and survives.

variants.label: three_blockers
variants.delta: B blocks Wolverine Pack with all three Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The rampage trigger resolves and Wolverine Pack gets +4/+4 until end of turn (two blockers beyond the first), becoming 6/8. It deals 2 damage to each of the three Grizzly Bears, so all three are destroyed. Wolverine Pack takes 6 damage and survives.

scenarios.title: The rampage bonus is calculated once, when the trigger resolves
decisions: A attacks player B with Wolverine Pack (2/4, rampage 2).
B blocks Wolverine Pack with both Grizzly Bears.
Wolverine Pack becomes blocked and its rampage trigger goes on the stack.

Base: both players pass and the trigger resolves; then A casts Lightning Bolt targeting one blocking Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain, and it resolves. Variant: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting one blocking Grizzly Bears with the trigger still on the stack, and it resolves before the trigger.
Combat damage: Wolverine Pack deals all of its damage to the remaining blocker.

variants.label: bolt_after_trigger_resolves
variants.expected: The rampage trigger resolves with two blockers and Wolverine Pack gets +2/+2, becoming 4/6. Lightning Bolt then destroys one Grizzly Bears, and Wolverine Pack stays 4/6 for the rest of the turn. In combat damage it deals 4 damage to the remaining Grizzly Bears (destroyed) and takes 2 damage.

variants.label: bolt_in_response
variants.delta: A casts Lightning Bolt in response to the rampage trigger instead of after it resolves.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt destroys one Grizzly Bears first, so only one creature blocks Wolverine Pack when the rampage trigger resolves. Wolverine Pack gets +0/+0 and stays 2/4. In combat damage it deals 2 damage to the remaining Grizzly Bears (destroyed) and takes 2 damage.
